scope: Compiled framework-independent TypeScript with injected transports and real Request/Response/Abort APIs; no network or backend integration.

checks.name: GET uses same-origin cookies, no-store, JSON accept and redirect refusal
External, protocol-relative, fragment, traversal and backslash paths never reach transport
Writes require a valid token before transport
Version/idempotency/CSRF headers and JSON body are passed exactly once
Weak tags, invalid keys and non-JSON bodies fail before writes
204 is decoded explicitly as null
ProblemDetails preserves HTTP status/code/trace and bounded validation messages
Unexpected HTML/JSON server errors do not leak body, title or detail
Malformed problem JSON retains safe HTTP failure
Each documented HTTP status has a safe recovery message
429 honors delta-seconds and HTTP-date Retry-After; values are bounded
Explicitly mapped fields do not map unknown properties or prototypes
Network errors are safe and do not trigger automatic retries
Failed writes are never automatically replayed
Pre-cancelled requests do not reach transport
In-flight cancellation differs from timeout
Cancellation after a late transport success cannot apply data
Malformed, wrong-media, oversized and schema-invalid successes are contract failures
Response and timeout limits reject invalid configurations
Currency display respects integer units, INR/JPY/KWD precision and invalid values
English date display uses explicit timezone and rejects ambiguous/invalid timestamps
